paid_ads.title: Aucier: AI story ad: sister's autistic son's meltdowns (sensory product)
paid_ads.what: "My autistic son's meltdowns were destroying our family until I found this…" A first-person family story told over AI-generated scenes. 108 s.
paid_ads.how: Write a first-person family-crisis narrative, generate scenes with AI, add VO, reveal the product as the turning point at 60-70%.

paid_ads.title: Pure Rhythm: Menopause reframe podcast (hair / energy)
paid_ads.what: "When your period stops, your brain literally cuts off the signal to your ovaries… that's the moment you need to say, no, I'm not going to waste away at 50. I still have 30 years ahead." 101 s.
paid_ads.how: An empowering reframe of the life stage, then the mechanism, then the product.

paid_ads.title: Mariella Gut Health Expert: "Gross embarrassing story time" gut yapper (Mariella Gut Health Expert)
paid_ads.what: A creator on a couch: "Alright, gross embarrassing story time! A few months ago I started noticing that my smells were… terrible… I was feeling bloated, icky… I consulted a few physicians, they said something was wrong with my gut health…" 105 s.
paid_ads.how: Couch, casual, pyjama energy. Say "gross/embarrassing" in the first 2 s, give 2-3 specific symptoms in their own words, what they tried, the doctor moment, then the product.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Don't exploit grief; keep it warm, not sad.
Avoid: The product must be the hidden mechanism, not the hero of every shot.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
